name: Convective Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as Convective Capital (convectivecapital.com; legal entity Convective Capital Management LLC per the site footer), the San Francisco early-stage venture firm WePay co-founder Bill Clerico started in 2022 to back wildfire ('Firetech') startups, now broadened to disaster resilience. Its Substack and Medium blogs (linked from the site) carry the Fund I and Fund II announcements; SEC EDGAR lists Convective Capital Fund I, L.P. and Fund II, L.P.; TechCrunch (May 2026) and portfolio press releases match. Also written 'Convective'. Not Conviction (Sarah Guo's AI fund) or Conviction Capital.

thesis_text.value: Specialist resilience investor that began in wildfire tech and now backs hardware, software and financial-services startups managing physical-world risk: grid and water infrastructure, insurance and risk transfer, tools for agencies and first responders, and industrials and supply chain. It deliberately targets slow, regulated, operationally complex markets and offers founders its 10,000-person Updraft network of utilities, insurers and agencies.

open_items: No application form or apply URL on convectivecapital.com; the about page says 'If you're building in this space We want to hear from you' and points to the team page, and the Request for Startups post invites founders to get in touch. application_url left out.
Check size not published. Only data point: Convective's own $2.5M investment in Voltair (Mar 2026). Fund II post says only 'bigger checks' than Fund I.

Nothing found on investing in Indian founders or on requiring a US entity; the firm led the seed of Toronto-based Molagri (Oct 2026) and backs Amsterdam-based Overstory, so a US entity does not appear to be mandatory, but this is not stated.

SEC EDGAR: the full-text search index lists Form D filers Convective Capital Fund I, L.P. (filed 2022-04-21, Beaverton, OR), Convective Capital Fund II, L.P. (filed 2025-01-07, San Francisco, CA) and Convective Strategic I, a series of Convective Capital Strategic Opportunities, L.P. (filed 2025-08-21, Lynnwood, WA). The Form D documents themselves were refused for the declared User-Agent, so offering amounts and the Strategic vehicle's size and purpose are unknown. An Axios Pro item (2025-01-09) on the Fund II filing is paywalled and was not read.
No street address on the site; HQ is from Bill Clerico's bio ('Based in San Francisco') and the Fund II Form D location.

Former part-time partners named in 2022 and 2024 (Anukool Lakhina, George Whitesides, Ilya Volodarsky) no longer appear on the team page; not recorded as partners. Partner focus_sectors are model-classified from bios (Clerico: wildfire/resilience; Ribakove: climate and built-environment risk at Munich Re Ventures); Mañalac (platform/community) and Trapanese (operations/strategic capital) have no sector focus.
Bill Clerico is named as one of Seneca's 'founding partners' on Seneca's launch page, alongside Convective co-leading Seneca's $60M round.

Rounds checked where the round page does not name Convective (not recorded): Pano AI $44M Series B, June 2025 (vcaonline.com / Latitude Media reprints of the release; GlobeNewswire original returned 403); Hubble Network $70M Series B and $200M Series C (hubble.com news); Stand $70M Series C, Oct 2026 (Fortune: 'among others').

Fund II investments without a round page naming Convective: Drafted (Convective's Dec 2025 post confirms the investment but gives no amount, stage or date), Edge Technologies, The Lumber Manufactory (Timber Industry News, Sep 2026, lists Convective among investors without a round). Not researched for lack of searches: Delos, Windborne, XBuild, FireAside, Blumen, Piq Energy, Instinct, Treeswift, BurnBot's and Gridware's seed rounds, Pano's earlier rounds.

Only 7 of the 9 rounds fall in the last 24 months; Rain (Sept 2023) and BurnBot (Apr 2024) are older. Voltair's round size and stage are undisclosed. TechCrunch misspells two portfolio names as 'Voltaire' and 'Raine'.

Molagri (agricultural biotech) has no matching sector id; classified health_bio by model. HQ and founding year not stated for Voltair, Rhizome and Rain; Overstory HQ (NL) is from its site's address metadata.
